title: Ipili language
description: Language of Enga Province, Papua New Guinea
extract: Ipili is an Engan language of the East New Guinea Highlands in Enga Province, Papua New Guinea. The name of the language means 'salt-people' in Huli language. There are 26,000 Ipili speakers.
